jobs.title: Head of Product, Pulse
jobs.description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

-
Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

-
Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

-
Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

Pulse is Sword Health's cardiometabolic program — an AI-first, clinician-backed experience that members stay with for months, not days. We're looking for a Head of Product to own it end to end: the roadmap, the AI experience, and the engagement engine that keeps members coming back.

This is a builder's seat, not a caretaker's. You'll take features from zero to one and then scale them to hundreds of thousands of members, designing agentic and conversational experiences on top of frontier models — and the eval frameworks that prove they're safe, accurate, and actually working. You'll own the metrics that matter (activation, engagement, retention, clinical outcomes) and partner closely with clinical, ML, design, and commercial teams to move them.

What you’ll be doing

Product Strategy & Execution

- Own the product roadmap from pre-launch through scale, balancing zero-to-one innovation with one-to-100 optimization.

- Define and prioritize features that drive member engagement, retention, and clinical outcomes across 4-12 month care journeys.

- Establish clear product metrics, success criteria, and feedback loops to rapidly iterate and improve the member experience.

- Partner with clinical, regulatory, and compliance teams to ensure product decisions meet healthcare standards while maintaining innovation velocity.

AI Product Leadership

- Design AI-first product experiences that leverage agentic capabilities, conversational interfaces, and personalized recommendations to deliver exceptional consumer value.

- Develop and implement evaluation frameworks (evals) to measure AI model performance, accuracy, safety, and member satisfaction.

- Maintain deep understanding of available AI models (LLMs, fine-tuning approaches) and make strategic decisions about which models to use for which use cases.

- Collaborate with clinical, ML engineering and applied AI teams to ensure safety and quality and optimize model performance, latency, cost, and reliability in production.

- Leverage AI tools throughout the product development lifecycle to accelerate research, prototyping, testing, and go-to-market preparation.

- Stay current on AI capabilities and emerging techniques, continuously evaluating how new developments can enhance the member experience.

Growth

- Build and execute strategies to drive member activation, and long-term retention in both B2C and B2B2C contexts.

- Design onboarding experiences, engagement loops, and re-engagement strategies optimized for sustained behavior change.

- Analyze member behavior, drop-off points, and engagement patterns to identify opportunities for product improvement.

- Partner with growth, marketing, and commercial teams to align product experience with go-to-market strategy.

- Develop hypotheses and run experiments to continuously improve conversion, engagement, and retention metrics.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Communication

- Serve as the product voice in executive discussions, client presentations, and sales cycles.

- Translate complex AI product concepts into compelling narratives for non-technical stakeholders, including clinical teams, executives, and clients.

- Collaborate with engineering, design, data science, clinical operations, and commercial teams to align on priorities and drive execution.

- Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across the organization to ensure the product has the support and resources needed to succeed.

What you need to have

- 6-8 years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on AI products or consumer-facing digital health products.

- Proven track record launching 0-to-1 products and scaling them to significant user bases (one-to-100).

- Deep experience with AI-first product development, including working with LLMs, designing agentic experiences, and building evaluation frameworks.

- Strong product sense for consumer experiences, particularly in products requiring sustained engagement over 4-12 month time horizons.

- Experience in B2C or consumer tech companies, with demonstrated expertise in growth, activation, and retention strategies.

- Nuanced understanding of different AI models, their capabilities and limitations, and how to maximize value from them in production.

- Comfort with ambiguity and ability to make decisions quickly with incomplete information.

- Excellent communication skills with ability to influence cross-functional teams and present to executive audiences.

What we would love to see

- Experience at high-growth startups where you've navigated rapid scaling and shifting priorities.

- Track record of leveraging AI tools (coding assistants, generative AI for research, automated testing) to accelerate product development timelines.

- Technical background or strong ability to collaborate deeply with engineering teams on AI implementation details.

- Experience designing products for both direct consumer and enterprise/B2B2C distribution models.

*The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role.

This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact.

Job titles may span more than one career level, so actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience, location, and market demand, among other factors. The range reflects base salary plus any variable, bonus, or sales incentives, and our estimate of the value of private company stock options where applicable. It's subject to change, and future stock value isn't guaranteed. Sword also offers additional benefits beyond total compensation.

Total Compensation Range
€278.850 — €359.350 EUR

Country-specific benefits may vary and will be detailed separately.

Role

We are looking for an ambitious, sharp, and execution-minded Product Marketing Lead to help build, define, and scale the future of AI Care across the Payor ecosystem, including Health Plans, Public Sector/Government entities, and Labor & Unions.

There has truly never been a better time to be a product marketer at Sword. We are actively launching category-defining products, expanding our platform capabilities, and completely redefining how care is delivered at population scale. In this role, you will be the primary GTM strategist and storytelling engine for our Payor business, taking a breakthrough AI platform narrative and turning it into hyper-resonant, high-converting commercial realities for health plan executives, medical directors, public sector procurement, and union trustees.

Why this role is unique

You aren't just selling a vendor solution; you are establishing a brand-new category in healthcare for the largest, most complex risk-bearing organizations in the country. You will be the connective tissue between our General Managers (our resident product experts), Payor leaders, and Marketing execution teams.

This is a high-impact, hands-on IC role designed for a PMM who thrives on navigating intricate healthcare ecosystems. You will partner directly with GMs to package our expanding platform, craft crisp value propositions for multi-stakeholder committees, and launch end-to-end campaigns that drive massive adoption. If you want to put your name on a category-defining brand while shipping high-leverage GTM work every single week—this is your sandbox.

What you’ll be doing

1. Payor Narrative & Audience Packaging

-
GM Co-Pilot: Partner hand-in-hand with General Managers to translate complex AI Care platform capabilities into compelling solution packages tailored to Commercial Health Plans, Public Sector, and Labor/Unions.

-
Packaging & Contracting Alignment: Take our overarching AI Care story and turn it into clear product packaging, value-based models, and solution offerings designed for payor contracting, ASO/FI structures, and trust fund requirements.

-
Actionable Buyer Mapping & Sales Plays: Map the complex payor buying matrix and translate those insights into actionable sales playbooks, RFP narrative blocks, pitch tracks, and objection toolkits that accelerate long-cycle payor deals.

2. Audience Positioning, Messaging & Asset Creation

-
Tailored Value Prop Development: Build sharp, differentiation-focused messaging frameworks that clearly articulate population health impact, cost-of-care reduction, accessibility, and clinical outcomes for payor audiences.

-
Rapid Messaging & Asset Testing: Continuously test, iterate, and refine positioning across payor channels, health plan pitch meetings, and RFP responses based on real-time market feedback.

-
High-Impact Content Creation: Own the production of Payor GTM assets end-to-end, from executive pitch decks and clinical impact summaries to RFP content blocks and partnership guides.

3. End-to-End Campaign Activation

-
Full-Funnel Payor Campaigns: Conceptualize, launch, and manage integrated product and audience campaigns end-to-end, driving everything from product drops to targeted push campaigns timed around payor planning cycles and trust fund cycles.

-
Payor Sales Enablement: Equip the Payor Commercial team with value props, sales plays, and pitch materials needed to win deals faster and at higher contract values.

-
Cross-Functional Execution: Work across Demand Gen, Brand, Events, and GMs to build orchestrated GTM pushes that build pipeline and cement our leadership in the employer market.

What you need to have

-
Category-Building Energy: 8+ years of B2B Product Marketing experience, with a track record of launching new products, crafting compelling narratives, and driving complex GTM activation.

-
Payor Ecosystem Domain Alignment: Deep experience marketing into healthcare payors, specifically Health Plans, Public Sector/Government programs, or Labor/Trust Funds. You understand medical management, health plan procurement, and member engagement dynamics.

-
Mastery of Positioning: Exceptional ability to take complex, cutting-edge technology and translate it into clear, credible, clinical, and financially persuasive value propositions for payor buyers.

-
Campaign & Execution Chops: A proven bias for action. You love taking campaigns from napkin sketch to market launch, measuring success by pipeline impact, deal velocity, and contract wins.

-
Cross-Functional Influence: Exceptional emotional intelligence and clarity to work alongside high-powered GMs, Product Managers, and Commercial executives.

-
Scrappy & Strategic: You can step back to look at macro payor category positioning, but you get equally excited about getting into the weeds to build a killer pitch deck or refine an RFP narrative.

-
AI-Augmented Marketer: You don't just market AI, you use it. You actively leverage modern AI tools to accelerate audience research, draft and test messaging variants, analyze deal intelligence, and scale your content output without sacrificing quality.

This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact.

Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to be the senior product presence embedded with the team building Pulse, Sword's AI-first care platform. You'll own definition and delivery for a meaningful slice of the roadmap end-to-end, while being the first person the Porto team turns to when something ambiguous or urgent comes up. This is a senior IC role, not a management position — you'll drive cross-functional squads (engineering, design, data, clinical) day to day without formal reporting lines.

What you’ll be doing

-
Own product definition through delivery for new features and initiatives in your area, defining the user, their struggle, and what a successful solution looks like;

-
Partnering with technical and non-technical stakeholders to properly scope those initiatives, by deep-diving into the underlying pain points, assessing the feasibility and scalability of proposed solutions, defining requirements, and acceptance criteria;

-
Support execution & iteration by working with other teams (Engineering, Product, Clinical, Operations) in tight feedback loops to make sure requirements are met, scope is adjusted as new information comes in, and development does not drift away from high-value product experiences;

-
Act as a strategy thought-partner: bring proposals and feature ideas to the Head of Product, and help explore, prioritize, and test them;

-
Communicate progress, learnings, and strategic recommendations clearly to leadership and cross-functional partners;

-
Use AI as a first-class tool in how Pulse itself is built, and increasingly, in how you work — Pulse leans on AI/LLM-driven features (Phoenix), so fluency with what's possible (and its limits) matters.

What you need to have

-
5+ years of experience in product management, ideally including consumer-facing digital health, wellness, or another B2C space with real behavior-change/retention dynamics;

-
Comfort owning ambiguity without a nearby manager: this role is the senior-most product judgment physically in the room with the build team;

-
Technical fluency: able to go deep with engineering on architecture and tradeoffs; comfortable with AI/LLM-powered product concepts even if you don't code yourself;

-
Strong written and verbal communication;

-
Data fluency: hypothesis-driven, comfortable defining metrics and reading dashboards to judge feature success (BigQuery/Looker experience a plus);

-
Bias for action and a real ability to disagree upward when the data or the team's read on the ground contradicts the plan.
